episodes.title: Parenting Beyond Your Own Childhood
episodes.description:
How do childhood experiences shape the way we raise our own children?

In this conversation, a former cult member, military veteran, and mother reflects on resilience, healing, and breaking generational patterns. She shares how being underestimated became a lifelong source of motivation, why performance should matter more than appearances, and how becoming a parent revealed the importance of addressing unresolved trauma before passing it to the next generation.

The discussion also explores parenting, financial perspective, cultural identity, and the challenge of accepting that children will develop their own worldview through experiences very different from those of their parents.


  👉 Curious to hear the full story? 
Watch the complete interview here: https://youtu.be/2S9fl-viHyw 
Discover more about their journey, insights, and unique experiences across the world.

#Parenting #Resilience #Leadership #Military #PersonalGrowth

episodes.title: Why Bad Leadership Works — Daniella Young
episodes.description:
Bad leadership is not rare. Daniella Young explains how cult dynamics, toxic groups, scams, politics, social media, and personal branding all connect.

Daniella is an author, speaker, veteran, cult survivor, and creator who has turned her story into a platform focused on bad leadership and bad groups. This conversation goes deep on why people follow destructive leaders, why nobody should assume they are immune to cults or scams, and how creators can build real influence without asking permission.

We discuss:
 • Why Daniella talks about bad leadership instead of good leadership
 • How she built a brand from her story, expertise, and lived experience
 • Why “followers” should never become worshippers
 • The difference between using a platform and platforming someone
 • Going on Khloe Kardashian’s show and handling backlash
 • Why smart people still fall for scams, cults, and manipulation
 • Traditional publishing vs self-publishing economics
 • Turning trauma into work without letting it consume you
 • How social media trolls can become part of the business model
 • Why veterans need new community and purpose after service
 • Parenting after growing up inside a cult
 • Politics, corruption, term limits, and America’s leadership problem
 • Why creators have more power than traditional media wants to admit

episodes.title: Daniella Mestyanek Young  Cult Survivor, Army Veteran, Author
episodes.description:
Daniella was born a third-generation member of the infamous Children of God religious cult, and grew up being trafficked around the world, before escaping that life and moving to America at age 15. 

She put herself through high school and graduated as college valedictorian before commissioning into the US Army as an intelligence officer. That’s where she really started to think about group behavior…and seeing it, well, everywhere.

episodes.title: From Cult Survivor to U.S. Army Officer & Author | Daniella Mestyanek Young’s Story
episodes.description:
Daniella Mestyanek Young — cult survivor, U.S. Army veteran, Harvard-trained organizational psychologist, and bestselling author — joins The Jason Cavness Experience to share her incredible journey from escaping the Children of God cult at 15 to breaking barriers in the military and becoming a thought leader on group psychology, leadership, and coercive control.

We cover:

How cult psychology shows up in workplaces, politics, and daily life

Lessons from serving on integrated combat teams in the U.S. Army

Why knitting became a tool for mental health and advocacy

How to protect your time and labor from coercion

Building authentic communities on TikTok and YouTube
